about.title: About
about.lead: A compact collection of Đồng Nai attractions, craft villages and OCOP products, with a map and an AI companion for directions and day plans.
about.purpose: Travel, craft and OCOP information is scattered. Buyers do not know where to buy, visitors do not know where to go in a day, and small makers have few channels to be found. This site gathers {n} entries, each with sources and an address you can actually visit.
how: It answers only from the {n} entries in the site data. If something is missing, it says so.
Distances and times are computed in code (road estimate is 1.35 times straight-line distance at 35 km/h), never guessed by the model.
It does not invent opening hours, ticket prices, phone numbers or restaurant names that are not in the data.
When the AI service is unreachable, basic mode still finds places and builds a plan by rules.
limits: Answers are for reference only; confirm opening hours and the route before leaving.
Distances are estimates for a car or motorbike on ordinary roads, without traffic.
Some positions are approximate (pins carry a dashed circle), especially makers and craft villages spread across several wards.
Entries not yet confirmed by an official source are flagged on the detail page.
about.source: Names and place names come from the project source listing. Each detail page has a "Sources" section so you can check for yourself. To add or correct an entry, bring an official source (government portal, department, park authority) so the team can verify it.
about.admin: Since 1 July 2025, Đồng Nai has merged with Bình Phước and district-level government has been removed. Since 30 April 2026, Đồng Nai is a centrally-run city. Addresses on these pages follow the original listing; some commune and ward names have changed after the reorganization, and a new address is shown only once it has been verified.
about.photos: The images shown are illustrations drawn for this project and labelled "Illustration". When real photos replace them, each photo needs an author, a licence and a source link; the list appears in the footer.
about.emergencyHint: Save these for the road, especially in forest areas such as Cát Tiên.
